column1: # The attic cache's secrets (its server env with the signing key and JWT secret, its TLS key, its served tokens) are
# never read by a session, through incus exec into the container, nor from the host that holds the dataset. Every
# other gesture into attic stays free (the lab's own, by the operator's decision of 2026-10-27). The paths are
# ndh's (modules/nixos/attic-cache.nix:32–37 container-side secretsDir, tlsDir, tokensDir; the host mounts
# ${hostRoot}/secrets and hostTls into them, attic-cache.nix:505–515, with hostRoot and hostTls from attic-cache.d/paths.nix).
# The TLS dir also holds PUBLIC files (cache-key.public, request.csr, cert.pem): those stay readable.
# Columns, tab-separated: want, today (d5b7eb2d, measured), cwd (- for /tmp/work), cmd. A case is loosened only with
# Inside the container, by incus exec: the three directories, any reader.

column4: ssh nikopol-nixos 'sudo incus exec attic-nikopol -- cat /var/lib/attic-secrets/server.env'

column1: # On the host, where the dataset lives (hostRoot): the same files, without incus.
# Everything else into attic stays free.

column4: incus exec attic-nikopol -- systemctl status atticd
